questions.question: Describe how you have participated across the SDLC, from requirements review through testing, release sign-off, and post-production support. Use an example from the Diesel or banking projects.

This role requires Oracle Cloud Fusion Financials and Oracle Integration Cloud experience. What exposure have you had to Oracle Cloud applications, Oracle Integration Cloud, or enterprise financial-system integrations?

You mention writing PL/SQL programs and SQL queries for database testing. Walk us through a complex query or PL/SQL validation you created, the business rule it verified, and how you investigated discrepancies.

How would you approach testing an Oracle Integration Cloud interface that transfers financial data between Oracle Fusion and another enterprise system? What validations would you perform across the source, integration layer, target, and error handling?
Tell us about a time you led QA team members or mentored junior testers. How did you set expectations, review their work, and address delivery or quality risks?
Describe your experience working in Agile teams, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, estimation, defect triage, reviews, and use of JIRA. What was your role in improving delivery outcomes?

Give an example of a production defect, hotfix, or release issue you helped investigate. How did you determine root cause, communicate impact to stakeholders, validate the fix, and decide whether the release could proceed?

You have developed Selenium Java automation using keyword-driven, hybrid, and page-object-model approaches. How did you decide what to automate, structure the framework, manage test data, and integrate execution with Jenkins or source control?

This role involves developing and validating BI Publisher and OTBI reports. Based on your reporting and database-testing experience, how would you validate that a financial report is accurate, secure, performant, and understandable to business users?

Describe a situation where requirements were incomplete, ambiguous, or changed during delivery. How did you uncover the missing details, document the impact, coordinate with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and update testing or release plans?
